title: EXTRACTION INBOUND 20 SECONDS
why: His 10-28 order: change inbound pre-extraction time from 30 secs to 20 secs. Old saved defaults and party settings migrate without changing other waits or preset C. The live siege interval scales with a shorter inbound wait so the same two light-haul or four full-haul arrivals fit before landing at the shipped siege dial; the total caps and boarding window stay the same. Watch: the ship lands 20 s after the call.
now: The ship lands 20 s after the call in career and demo. Old saved 30 s defaults load as 20 s. Watch the shorter wait and siege arrivals.

// v28.xx (cw-cx-extractwait20): the arrival rate was tuned to a 30 s inbound wait. Compress shorter live waits proportionally, keeping the same arrivals by landing and the same cap. The headless sim keeps its arrival rate.
function siegeIvOf(GR){ return (SIEGE_IV-SIEGE_IV_HAUL*clamp(GR,0,1))*((typeof G!=='undefined'&&G&&!G.sim)?Math.min(1,CFG.extractWait/30):1); }
